question: A force is commonly described as:
urdu_translation: force کو عام طور پر کیسے describe کیا جاتا ہے؟
A: A push or a pull / push یا pull
B: Only a change in mass / صرف mass میں change
C: Energy per unit time / energy per unit time
D: Distance per unit time / distance per unit time
correct_answer: A | A push or a pull / push یا pull

question: Which effect can a force produce on velocity?
urdu_translation: force velocity پر کون سا effect produce کر سکتی ہے؟
A: Change its magnitude, direction or both / magnitude، direction یا دونوں change کر سکتی ہے
B: Change only mass / صرف mass change کرتی ہے
C: Change only temperature / صرف temperature change کرتی ہے
D: Remove all inertia / تمام inertia remove کرتی ہے
correct_answer: A | Change its magnitude, direction or both / magnitude، direction یا دونوں change کر سکتی ہے

question: A contact force acts:
urdu_translation: contact force کہاں act کرتی ہے؟
A: Only through empty space / صرف empty space کے through
B: Only inside atomic nuclei / صرف atomic nuclei کے اندر
C: Without any interaction / کسی interaction کے بغیر
D: At the point of contact between objects / objects کے point of contact پر
correct_answer: D | At the point of contact between objects / objects کے point of contact پر

question: Which of the following is a contact force?
urdu_translation: درج ذیل میں سے کون سی contact force ہے؟
A: Gravitational force / gravitational force
B: Electrostatic force / electrostatic force
C: Friction / friction
D: Magnetic force / magnetic force
correct_answer: C | Friction / friction

question: A non-contact force is also called a field force because:
urdu_translation: non-contact force کو field force کیوں کہا جاتا ہے؟
A: It acts only at contact / یہ صرف contact پر act کرتی ہے
B: It has no direction / اس کی direction نہیں ہوتی
C: A field is associated with it / اس کے ساتھ field associated ہوتی ہے
D: It exists only in liquids / یہ صرف liquids میں exist کرتی ہے
correct_answer: C | A field is associated with it / اس کے ساتھ field associated ہوتی ہے

question: Which of the following is a non-contact force?
urdu_translation: درج ذیل میں سے کون سی non-contact force ہے؟
A: Air resistance / air resistance
B: Electrostatic force / electrostatic force
C: Friction / friction
D: Tension in a string / string میں tension
correct_answer: B | Electrostatic force / electrostatic force

question: How many fundamental forces are listed in nature in this chapter?
urdu_translation: chapter میں nature کی fundamental forces کتنی listed ہیں؟

question: Which force holds protons and neutrons together in the nucleus?
urdu_translation: nucleus میں protons اور neutrons کو کون سی force hold کرتی ہے؟
A: Strong nuclear force / strong nuclear force
B: Gravitational force / gravitational force
C: Frictional force / frictional force
D: Air resistance / air resistance
correct_answer: A | Strong nuclear force / strong nuclear force

question: Which force is responsible for beta decay according to the chapter?
urdu_translation: chapter کے مطابق beta decay کے لیے کون سی force responsible ہے؟
A: Strong nuclear force / strong nuclear force
B: Weak nuclear force / weak nuclear force
C: Normal force / normal force
D: Tension force / tension force
correct_answer: B | Weak nuclear force / weak nuclear force

question: Dr. Abdus Salam shared the 1979 Nobel Prize for work related to the unification of:
urdu_translation: Dr. Abdus Salam نے 1979 Nobel Prize کس forces کی unification سے related work پر share کیا؟
A: Gravity and friction / gravity اور friction
B: Weak nuclear and electromagnetic forces / weak nuclear اور electromagnetic forces
C: Strong nuclear and gravitational forces / strong nuclear اور gravitational forces
D: Tension and normal forces / tension اور normal forces
correct_answer: B | Weak nuclear and electromagnetic forces / weak nuclear اور electromagnetic forces

question: Newton's law of gravitation states that force is inversely proportional to:
urdu_translation: Newton's law of gravitation کے مطابق force کس quantity کے inversely proportional ہے؟
A: Product of the masses / masses کے product
B: Sum of the masses / masses کے sum
C: Time of interaction / interaction کے time
D: Square of the distance between masses / masses کے درمیان distance کے square
correct_answer: D | Square of the distance between masses / masses کے درمیان distance کے square

question: The value of the gravitational constant given in the chapter is approximately:
urdu_translation: chapter میں gravitational constant کی value تقریباً کیا دی گئی ہے؟
A: 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N·m²/kg²
B: 9.8 N/kg
C: 10 m/s²
correct_answer: A | 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N·m²/kg²

question: A free-body diagram shows:
urdu_translation: free-body diagram کیا show کرتا ہے؟
A: Only the path of motion / صرف motion کا path
B: Only the mass of the object / صرف object کی mass
C: Magnitudes and directions of forces acting on an object / object پر acting forces کی magnitudes اور directions
D: Temperature changes in an object / object میں temperature changes
correct_answer: C | Magnitudes and directions of forces acting on an object / object پر acting forces کی magnitudes اور directions

question: In a free-body diagram, the length of a force arrow represents:
urdu_translation: free-body diagram میں force arrow کی length کیا represent کرتی ہے؟
A: Mass of the object / object کی mass
B: Magnitude of the force / force کی magnitude
C: Time of action / action کا time
D: Unit of acceleration / acceleration کی unit
correct_answer: B | Magnitude of the force / force کی magnitude

question: A book pushed across a table normally has which four forces shown on its free-body diagram?
urdu_translation: table پر push کی گئی book کے free-body diagram میں normally کون سی four forces show ہوتی ہیں؟
A: Only weight and velocity / صرف weight اور velocity
B: Magnetic, nuclear, heat and light forces / magnetic، nuclear، heat اور light forces
C: Applied force, friction, normal force and weight / applied force، friction، normal force اور weight
D: Momentum, energy, mass and time / momentum، energy، mass اور time
correct_answer: C | Applied force, friction, normal force and weight / applied force، friction، normal force اور weight

question: Newton's first law is also called the law of:
urdu_translation: Newton's first law کو کس law کا نام بھی دیا جاتا ہے؟
A: Momentum / momentum
B: Pressure / pressure
C: Inertia / inertia
D: Conservation of energy / conservation of energy
correct_answer: C | Inertia / inertia

question: Inertia is the property of a body to resist change in its state of:
urdu_translation: inertia body کی کس state میں change کو resist کرنے کی property ہے؟
A: Temperature only / صرف temperature
B: Shape only / صرف shape
C: Electric charge only / صرف electric charge
D: Rest or uniform motion / rest یا uniform motion
correct_answer: D | Rest or uniform motion / rest یا uniform motion

question: Which object has greater inertia?
urdu_translation: کون سا object greater inertia رکھتا ہے؟
A: The object with greater temperature / greater temperature والا object
B: The object with greater mass / greater mass والا object
C: The object with smaller volume only / صرف smaller volume والا object
D: The object with brighter colour / brighter colour والا object
correct_answer: B | The object with greater mass / greater mass والا object

question: Newton's second law is represented by:
urdu_translation: Newton's second law کس equation سے represent ہوتا ہے؟
A: p = mv
B: W = Fs
C: P = W/t
D: F = ma
correct_answer: D | F = ma

question: For a fixed force, acceleration is inversely proportional to:
urdu_translation: fixed force کے لیے acceleration کس کے inversely proportional ہے؟
A: Velocity / velocity
B: Mass / mass
C: Time / time
D: Distance / distance
correct_answer: B | Mass / mass

question: A 10 kg block accelerates at 2 m/s². The net force is:
urdu_translation: 10 kg block، 2 m/s² سے accelerate کرتا ہے۔ net force معلوم کریں۔
A: 5 N
correct_answer: D | 20 N

question: Newton's third law states that action and reaction are:
urdu_translation: Newton's third law کے مطابق action اور reaction کیا ہوتے ہیں؟
A: Equal in magnitude and opposite in direction / magnitude میں equal اور direction میں opposite
B: Equal and in the same direction / equal اور same direction میں
C: Unequal and perpendicular / unequal اور perpendicular
D: Acting on the same body / same body پر acting
correct_answer: A | Equal in magnitude and opposite in direction / magnitude میں equal اور direction میں opposite

question: Action and reaction do not cancel each other because they act on:
urdu_translation: action اور reaction ایک دوسرے کو cancel کیوں نہیں کرتے؟
A: The same body at the same point / same body کے same point پر
B: No body / کسی body پر نہیں
C: Two different bodies / two different bodies
D: Only the Earth / صرف Earth پر
correct_answer: C | Two different bodies / two different bodies

question: Newton's laws need relativistic mechanics when objects move:
urdu_translation: Newton's laws کے لیے relativistic mechanics کب required ہوتی ہے؟
A: At ordinary walking speed / ordinary walking speed پر
B: Only in a straight line / صرف straight line میں
C: Only in liquids / صرف liquids میں
D: Close to the speed of light / speed of light کے close
correct_answer: D | Close to the speed of light / speed of light کے close

question: Mass is a measure of:
urdu_translation: mass کس چیز کی measure ہے؟
A: Gravitational force only / صرف gravitational force
B: Area of a body / body کا area
C: Speed of a body / body کی speed
D: Quantity of matter / quantity of matter
correct_answer: D | Quantity of matter / quantity of matter

question: Weight is calculated using:
urdu_translation: weight کس formula سے calculate کیا جاتا ہے؟
A: W = mg
B: W = m/g
C: W = mv
D: W = F/A
correct_answer: A | W = mg

question: Which statement correctly compares mass and weight?
urdu_translation: mass اور weight کا correct comparison کون سا ہے؟
A: Mass and weight are both measured in newtons / mass اور weight دونوں newtons میں measure ہوتے ہیں
B: Weight is scalar and mass is vector / weight scalar اور mass vector ہے
C: Mass is scalar and nearly constant; weight is a force / mass scalar اور تقریباً constant ہے؛ weight ایک force ہے
D: Mass changes with location but weight never changes / mass location سے change ہوتی ہے مگر weight کبھی change نہیں ہوتا
correct_answer: C | Mass is scalar and nearly constant; weight is a force / mass scalar اور تقریباً constant ہے؛ weight ایک force ہے

question: Which instrument measures weight directly in newtons?
urdu_translation: کون سا instrument weight کو directly newtons میں measure کرتا ہے؟
A: Force meter or spring balance / force meter یا spring balance
B: Physical balance / physical balance
C: Metre rule / metre rule
D: Stopwatch / stopwatch
correct_answer: A | Force meter or spring balance / force meter یا spring balance

question: A physical balance determines mass by comparing an object with:
urdu_translation: physical balance object کی mass کس کے ساتھ compare کرکے determine کرتی ہے؟
A: Known temperature values / known temperature values
B: A liquid column / liquid column
C: A magnetic field / magnetic field
D: Known standard masses / known standard masses
correct_answer: D | Known standard masses / known standard masses

question: Static friction acts:
urdu_translation: static friction کب act کرتی ہے؟
A: Only after the object leaves the surface / object کے surface چھوڑنے کے بعد
B: Before relative motion starts / relative motion start ہونے سے پہلے
C: Only in a vacuum / صرف vacuum میں
D: Only in circular motion / صرف circular motion میں
correct_answer: B | Before relative motion starts / relative motion start ہونے سے پہلے

question: The maximum value of static friction is called:
urdu_translation: static friction کی maximum value کو کیا کہتے ہیں؟
A: Rolling friction / rolling friction
B: Air resistance / air resistance
C: Impulse / impulse
D: Limiting friction / limiting friction
correct_answer: D | Limiting friction / limiting friction

question: Rolling friction is generally:
urdu_translation: rolling friction generally کیسی ہوتی ہے؟
A: Much less than sliding friction / sliding friction سے بہت less
B: Greater than sliding friction / sliding friction سے greater
C: Equal to gravitational force / gravitational force کے equal
D: Independent of surfaces / surfaces سے independent
correct_answer: A | Much less than sliding friction / sliding friction سے بہت less

question: Which method reduces friction in machinery by converting sliding into rolling?
urdu_translation: machinery میں sliding friction کو rolling میں convert کرکے friction reduce کرنے کا method کون سا ہے؟
A: Increasing roughness / roughness increase کرنا
B: Using ball bearings / ball bearings use کرنا
C: Removing lubrication / lubrication remove کرنا
D: Making the vehicle front flat / vehicle front flat بنانا
correct_answer: B | Using ball bearings / ball bearings use کرنا

question: Terminal velocity is reached when upward air resistance becomes:
urdu_translation: terminal velocity کب reach ہوتی ہے؟
A: Zero / zero
B: Less than all forces at every instant / ہر instant پر تمام forces سے less
C: Equal to the downward weight / downward weight کے equal
D: Perpendicular to weight / weight کے perpendicular
correct_answer: C | Equal to the downward weight / downward weight کے equal

question: Momentum is defined as:
urdu_translation: momentum کی definition کیا ہے؟
A: Product of mass and velocity / mass اور velocity کا product
B: Force per unit area / force per unit area
C: Work per unit time / work per unit time
D: Mass per unit volume / mass per unit volume
correct_answer: A | Product of mass and velocity / mass اور velocity کا product

question: The SI unit of momentum may be written as:
urdu_translation: momentum کی SI unit کس طرح لکھی جا سکتی ہے؟
A: N/m²
B: J/s
C: kg/m³
D: kg·m/s
correct_answer: D | kg·m/s

question: Impulse is equal to:
urdu_translation: impulse کس کے equal ہے؟
A: Change in momentum / change in momentum
B: Mass divided by velocity / mass divided by velocity
C: Force divided by time / force divided by time
D: Pressure times area only / صرف pressure times area
correct_answer: A | Change in momentum / change in momentum

question: A 0.015 kg bullet moves at 150 m/s. Its momentum is:
urdu_translation: 0.015 kg bullet، 150 m/s سے move کرتی ہے۔ momentum معلوم کریں۔
A: 0.10 kg·m/s
B: 15 kg·m/s
C: 2.25 kg·m/s
D: 2250 kg·m/s
correct_answer: C | 2.25 kg·m/s

question: The total momentum of an isolated system remains constant when:
urdu_translation: isolated system کا total momentum کب constant رہتا ہے؟
A: Friction is maximum / friction maximum ہو
B: No external force acts on it / اس پر کوئی external force act نہ کرے
C: The masses are equal only / صرف masses equal ہوں
D: All bodies are at rest after collision / تمام bodies collision کے بعد rest میں ہوں
correct_answer: B | No external force acts on it / اس پر کوئی external force act نہ کرے

question: The backward recoil of a gun after firing is explained by conservation of:
urdu_translation: firing کے بعد gun کا backward recoil کس conservation سے explain ہوتا ہے؟
A: Pressure / pressure
B: Density / density
C: Momentum / momentum
D: Temperature / temperature
correct_answer: C | Momentum / momentum
